items.name: Inventory and reference
items.scope: Inspect the actual branch and record present, partial and missing capabilities.
acceptance: A pinned capability matrix and twelve reproducible scenes.

items.name: Shared scene contract and persistence
items.scope: Separate engineering, appearance, rig, environment, camera and shot.
acceptance: Atomic validated settings, undo and offline reopen.

items.name: Physical rendering foundation
items.scope: Implement global transport, areas, HDR environment, ground and geometric precision.
acceptance: Convergent opaque reference scenes and bounded resource use.

items.name: Appearance and color
items.scope: Provide layered surfaces, physical texture scale, projections and color management.
acceptance: Fundamental product finishes with stable reference views.

items.name: Complete user journey
items.scope: Connect library, inspector, preview and export.
acceptance: A novice can produce and reproduce a product image.

items.name: First verified resource pack
items.scope: Select 40-60 appearances, 20-30 rigs and 20-30 environments that work end to end.
acceptance: Every published resource has supported dependencies and acceptance evidence.

items.name: Product optics
items.scope: Add transmission, absorption, nested media, anisotropy, coats and subsurface response.
acceptance: Glass vial, liquid, brushed metal and silicone reference scenes.

items.name: Lighting and stages
items.scope: Add photometric sources, emitters, skies and three-dimensional staging.
acceptance: Rigs have unambiguous ownership and correct parallax.

items.name: Studio and variants
items.scope: Add decals, cameras, A/B comparison and queues.
acceptance: Repeatable product-family presentations.

items.name: Production and interchange
items.scope: Add denoising, EXR, passes, portable packs and recovery.
acceptance: Production masters with traceable requests.

items.name: Expanded catalog publication
items.scope: Bind and publish supported families progressively toward the 600/280/280 catalog; retain unsupported specialized records as concepts.
acceptance: Each published family has validated resources and resolved capability dependencies; specialized completion also requires the relevant F11 capabilities.

items.name: Specialized rendering
items.scope: Develop caustics, displacement, volume and spectral features as measured pilots.
acceptance: Each expensive feature has a demonstrable benefit and explicit limits.

items.name: Competitive quality and release
items.scope: Measure quality, task success, performance and platform support.
acceptance: Comparable scenes and documented time-to-quality results.

items.name: SELENE model binding
items.scope: Acquire and pin the documented improved SELENE-showcase native file; verify its loops, links, grounding and motion studies, then bind reviewed appearance roles.
acceptance: Improved source hash, derivative provenance and notices recorded; v7 fallback rejected.
Native and runtime mechanism acceptance checks completed; exact targets reviewed.

items.name: Lunar still-render demonstration
items.scope: Build procedural terrain and strict physical lunar lighting with calibrated appearances.
acceptance: Hero and macro shots pass contact, scale, light and image checks.

items.name: Animation and dynamics foundation
items.scope: Extend existing kinematic studies, IK and motion analysis with SI dynamics, rigid-body inertia, bounded actuation, continuous contact, events and analytic benchmarks.
acceptance: Validated release and contact behavior independent of rendering.

items.name: Sampling and sample-container states
items.scope: Implement collection, mass transfer, closure and independent vial bodies.
acceptance: A sealed sample retains mass and has a valid collision representation.

items.name: Throw catch and storage demonstration
items.scope: Plan release, flight, reachable contact capture and cassette retention.
acceptance: The solver can report failure and never teleports the vial.

items.name: Final animation production
items.scope: Bake approved motion and render temporally stable frames at quality targets.
acceptance: Every frame traces to the same approved physics and resource manifests.
